_source: Same fields as the input of the real run that produced the dataset export (user-supplied, 2026-10-06), with hashtags/resultsPerPage turned into placeholders. Field names and enum values checked against the actor build's real OpenAPI definition (src/test/resources/actor-input-schema.json, test-guarded). Not yet run through validate-input. Keys starting with '_' are notes and are never sent.
_todo: Run `validate-input --kind search` before the first real run.

downloadSubtitlesOptions is deliberately omitted (default NEVER_DOWNLOAD_SUBTITLES): the real export still had videoMeta.subtitleLinks and we download the VTT ourselves. Valid values are NEVER_DOWNLOAD_SUBTITLES | DOWNLOAD_SUBTITLES | DOWNLOAD_AND_TRANSCRIBE_VIDEOS_WITHOUT_SUBTITLES | TRANSCRIBE_ALL_VIDEOS; the last two use the actor's paid speech-to-text and must NOT be used.
pay-per-event actor: query param maxItems does not apply, so the item cap is resultsPerPage (per hashtag) plus maxTotalChargeUsd.
